Overview

Kiambu is a city in Kiambu with a population of 150,000. A rapidly growing town in central Kenya, part of the greater Nairobi metropolitan area. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
